scope: Pairwise geometry buckets evaluated against one shared chronological DEV/VALIDATION/HOLDOUT partition

methodology.search: all unordered pairs across eight fixed geometry definitions
methodology.split: single global chronological thirds across the complete classified trade universe; the same date boundaries apply to every pair
methodology.selectionGate: DEV and VALIDATION each n >= 8, PF >= 1, avgR > 0
methodology.holdout: Untouched global third; never used for candidate ranking
methodology.warning: Pairwise multiple-comparison risk remains. Positive HOLDOUT results are exploratory evidence only and require pre-specified follow-up robustness tests.
